tools.name: GitHub MCP Server
tools.description: Official Model Context Protocol server for GitHub. Lets an agent read repositories, open pull requests, triage issues, and manage workflows across your GitHub organizations with scoped, auditable access.

tools.name: Slack MCP Server
tools.description: Connect an agent to Slack workspaces: read channel history, post messages, manage reminders, and look up teammates. Scoped per-workspace tokens with granular chat permissions.

tools.name: Notion MCP Server
tools.description: Official Notion MCP integration. Agents can search pages and databases, create documentation, update project notes, and keep a team knowledge base current through natural language requests.

tools.name: Stripe MCP Connector
tools.description: Model Context Protocol connector for Stripe. Enables agents to look up charges, inspect customer records, and draft payment links for review. Read-first design with explicit confirmation for any write action on billing data.

tools.name: Sentry MCP Server
tools.description: Bring Sentry error monitoring into agent workflows: query recent issues, inspect stack traces, correlate releases with error spikes, and summarize crash patterns for on-call engineers.

tools.name: PostgreSQL MCP Server
tools.description: Community-maintained MCP server exposing PostgreSQL databases to agents. Supports schema inspection and parameterized queries with optional read-write mode controlled by connection configuration.

tools.name: Filesystem MCP Server
tools.description: Reference MCP server from Anthropic for local filesystem access. Agents can list directories, read files, and write within administrator-approved roots only; every access is logged locally.

tools.name: Browserbase MCP Server
tools.description: Cloud browser infrastructure exposed via MCP. Agents can drive isolated browser sessions, navigate sites, capture screenshots, and extract structured page data without local setup.

tools.name: Google Drive MCP Server
tools.description: MCP interface to Google Drive: search documents, read file contents, and organize folders. OAuth-scoped so an agent only reaches the drives and folders explicitly granted to it.

tools.name: Atlassian Jira MCP Server
tools.description: Official Atlassian MCP server for Jira. Agents can query tickets, transition issue states, log work, and generate sprint reports while respecting project-level permission schemes.

tools.name: Linear MCP Server
tools.description: Linear's MCP integration for issue tracking. Lets agents create and update issues, query project roadmaps, and summarize team velocity with API keys scoped to single teams.

tools.name: Expensify MCP Integration
tools.description: Community-built MCP bridge to Expensify. Track team expenses, submit expense reports, attach receipts, and reconcile corporate card transactions from natural language prompts.

tools.name: Zapier MCP
tools.description: Give agents access to Zapier's automation catalog: trigger zaps, check run history, and connect thousands of SaaS apps through one managed MCP endpoint with per-action approval controls.

tools.name: Supabase MCP Server
tools.description: Official Supabase MCP server. Agents can query Postgres tables, inspect schemas, and manage edge function deployments across Supabase projects with organization-level access controls.

tools.name: Weather
tools.description: Live current-weather lookups via Open-Meteo: get temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind speed, and conditions for any city. First-party, keyless, read-only.

tools.name: npm Package Lookup
tools.description: Look up an npm package by name and get its published version, description, license, links, top maintainers, and a quality/popularity/maintenance score from npms.io. First-party, keyless, read-only.

tools.name: PyPI Package Lookup
tools.description: Resolve any package on PyPI: latest version, summary, Python requirement, license, project links, and release history from the official PyPI JSON API. First-party, keyless, read-only.

tools.name: Web Search
tools.description: Keyless web search via the DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API: headline answer, definition, and related links for a query without scraping pages. First-party, read-only.
